resolver_rules.description: A client asks for an update, or a week passes without one
A bill, an invoice or a bank transaction arrives
A client asks about an invoice, a payment or what was agreed
A task has had no progress for 3 days
A grant call, a deck or a Google Doc needs work

skills.name: Client update
steps: Read the project's last update and what changed since in the meeting transcript, Slack or WhatsApp.
Draft a short written update, with a line on what is next.
Propose reply_customer with the draft in the client's own channel. A steward approves it before it is sent.
If the client asked for something the project lead has not agreed, use escalate.

skills.name: Transcript to tasks
steps: Read the transcript and list every task said out loud, with its owner and due date.
Check the open tasks so that nothing is listed twice.
Propose reply_customer to post the task list to the team channel and remind the owners.
If a task has no clear owner, use escalate to the project lead.

skills.name: Spend check
steps: Read this month's bills and subscriptions and last month's spend.
Compare with the budget in the spend policy.
If spend is more than 20 percent over budget, or a new subscription is above USD 50, use escalate with the figures.

skills.name: Client questions
steps: Find the agreement, invoice or payment the client asks about in the documents.
Answer from the payment terms and the refund policy, citing them.
If the documents do not answer, use escalate.

skills.name: Member progress check
steps: Read the merged work and the task list for each member.
Find tasks with no progress for 3 days, or work merged that was never posted.
Propose reply_customer to ask the owner for a short progress note in the team channel.
If the same task stays quiet after the reminder, use escalate to the project lead.

skills.name: Grant and document draft
steps: Read the call, the last draft and what the team has built since.
List what is missing against the call: summary, budget, letters, open results plan.
Use escalate to hand the missing list and the draft to the owner of the application.

knowledge.text: The project lead sends client updates when they judge the work is ready to show.
A client who asks for an update is answered the same working day.
A steward approves every message to a client before it is sent, whether it is a weekly update, a video or a reply.
A weekly update goes to each active client by Friday 17:00 Colombo time, in the client's own channel.
A client who asks for an update is answered within 4 working hours, and the answer names what changed since the last update.
A client may ask for a refund within 7 days of paying an invoice.
Refunds up to USD 200 inside the window are approved automatically.
A client may ask for a refund within 14 days of paying an invoice.
Refunds up to USD 500 inside the window are approved automatically.
Refunds above USD 500, or requests after 14 days, need approval from the founder.
Monthly cloud spend (Blaze plan) has a budget of USD 700 and tools and subscriptions a budget of USD 500.
Monthly cloud spend (Blaze plan) has a budget of USD 900 and tools and subscriptions a budget of USD 600.
Any new tool or subscription above USD 50 a month needs the founder's approval before it is bought.
Spend is reviewed on the 5th of each month. Spend more than 20 percent over budget raises an alert to the founder.
Every task agreed in a meeting has one owner and a due date, written down within 24 hours of the meeting.
The owner gets a reminder the day before the task is due. A task with no progress for 3 days is raised with the project lead.
Invoices are issued through Stripe and are due 15 days after issue. A project starts after the first 50 percent is paid.
Clients outside the US may pay by bank transfer to Wise or Mercury. Contractors are paid from Wise on the 28th of each month.
Meeting recordings and transcripts are kept 180 days, then deleted. Clients are told at the start of a recorded meeting.
Client personal data is masked before an agent reads it. Only a steward can see the original.
